summary: Readiness review for iteration `feedback-request-batch-upload` succeeded. The prerequisite `authenticated-dashboard-shell` is implemented and approved: protected `/dashboard` exists, sign-in and registration target `/dashboard`, the Feedback Request route is present as a protected placeholder at `src/app/dashboard/feedback-request/page.tsx`, and the dashboard shell includes Home, Feedback Request, Configure, logout, identity display, and theme toggle. The requested upload scope is clear: replace the placeholder with an authenticated Excel upload workflow, validate `email`, `type`, `product_code`, `product_name`, and `purchase_date`, support only `type=purchase`, create traceable feedback batch and feedback rows, generate unique feedback-link identifiers, and email customers through a testable sender without contacting real customers in tests. Current Prisma schema has no FeedbackBatch/Feedback models and package dependencies do not include an Excel parser (`npm.cmd ls nodemailer @types/nodemailer xlsx exceljs zod --depth=0` returned an empty tree), but those are expected implementation work, not readiness blockers. Gmail env key names `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM` are present, and the existing welcome-email SMTP implementation provides a reusable pattern for server-only, injectable email delivery. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs` with 17/17 passing. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email sending were not run per task constraints.
